title: Print Window Element Taxonomy
description: Restrict semio print window chrome to 14 special document element kinds (Visual/Logical/Structural tiers with primary/secondary/tertiary border+fill). Remove chapter/section auto-windowing. Retire Semiobox. Migrate existing call sites.
summary: Added consistent single-unit spacing between element windows: each window environment now inserts \addvspace{\semio@spacing@single} before its header chip, giving uniform gaps between consecutive windows without doubling when stacked.
